info.name: SAMS — Assignment demonstration and validation
info.description: Run in order against a disposable seeded database. Creates synthetic accounts, an offering, enrollments and dated classes. Includes success/invalid requests, assertions and saved sample responses. Duplicate attendance retries are deliberately idempotent (200); duplicate account/offering/enrollment creation returns 409. Do not run on real university records.
